entity.name: Karol Broda
entity.description: Solo maintainer of Pith, a computation kernel for build, package, environment, and system tooling. The project is developed part-time, about twelve hours a week, alongside employment.

projects.name: Pith
projects.description: a computation kernel for build, package, environment, and system tooling

channels.description: Bank transfer; account details on request.

plans.name: Publishable domain libraries
plans.description: A domain library can be written today but neither published nor consumed: there is no module system and no registry. This adds workspaces and a lock, the publication path over a real transport, and the documentation a third-party author needs, ending in a tagged release. Covers WP1, WP2, WP5: 340 hours over 12 months.

plans.name: A generic builder, authored in the surface notation
plans.description: The kernel's compile-and-link builder is authored in Rust. This re-authors it in Pith's own notation, the proof that a domain author can extend the system without touching the kernel, and adds the source-fetch path that verifies upstream sources against their declared digest. Covers WP3: 180 hours over 12 months.

plans.name: Provenance derived from the build graph
plans.description: Every build step is already recorded as a computation. This derives an SPDX SBOM and an in-toto attestation in SLSA form from those records, so a build's provenance comes from the build itself, not from a scan afterwards. Covers WP4: 100 hours over 12 months.

plans.name: Reproducibility verification and executor hardening
plans.description: Re-executes recorded actions to localize non-determinism to the exact computation that caused it, finishes run bounds and partial cancellation in the confined executor, and extends CI to aarch64 so the sandbox paths are exercised on a second architecture. Covers WP6, WP7, WP8: 210 hours over 12 months.

plans.name: Sustaining support
plans.description: Any amount toward the open workplan, without a grant process.
